subject: Dedicated capacity intake — Stratify AI (throughput / latency details & schedule)
messages:
From: Alex Pearson <alex.pearson@stratify.ai>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Dedicated capacity demo / intake — Stratify AI

Hi Grace —

We signed up via the self-serve flow last night and selected the Dedicated capacity trial. We're preparing requirements and would like to schedule a focused walkthrough next week to validate throughput and latency targets before we commit to reserved capacity.

High-level context: Stratify is building a real-time summarization product for enterprise chat with a peak workload profile of ~1.2k concurrent users and bursts up to ~6k QPS for short periods. Our rough token estimates are ~60M tokens/day. Latency target is P95 < 120ms for single-turn generation (we know that's tight).

Can we book a 45-minute technical demo with someone from the Dedicated product/serving team + an ops/infra engineer? We can provide sample prompts and a small dataset.

Preferred windows (PST):
- Tue 6/19 10:30–11:15
- Wed 6/20 15:00–15:45

Thanks — appreciate the quick help.

Alex
Alex Pearson
Head of Platform
Stratify AI
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: none
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Pearson <alex.pearson@stratify.ai>, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Dedicated capacity demo / intake — Stratify AI

Alex — thanks for signing up and for the context. I'm the SDR on this intake; looping in Grace (AM) and Priyom (Solutions) so we can lock the right folks.

We can do a 45-min technical intake focused on Dedicated capacity and throughput/latency tradeoffs. Quick ask before we confirm: could you confirm whether the 6k QPS burst is sustained for more than a minute, and whether requests are mostly short completions (~50–150 tokens) or longer (~500+ tokens)? That helps us pick the right model/quantization profile and reserve size.

Proposed times (PST) — please pick one or suggest alternatives:
- Tue 6/19 10:30–11:15 (your first option) — calendar tentative
- Thu 6/21 09:00–09:45 — fallback with our infra lead available

We'll also attach a short "Dedicated sizing" worksheet for you to fill with expected QPS/sequence lengths so our solutions team can size GPU pools. Grace — can you bring someone from the Serving runtime team? Priyom can run the throughput checklist.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Pearson <alex.pearson@stratify.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Dedicated capacity demo / intake — Stratify AI

Thanks Alex — we're excited to dig in. Priyom and Monica (solutions + deployment engineer) will join. A couple of quick clarifications so we can come prepared:

1) Workload shape: if bursts are sub-60s and mostly short completions, we can rely on autoscaled Dedicated pools with burst credits. If bursts are sustained for multiple minutes we'll need a different pooling strategy (reserved GPUs for peak).
2) Token distribution: a mix of short (70–150 tokens) for most requests and ~10% longer sessions (~400–700 tokens).

I've attached our SLA / capacity checklist and a quick calendar invite for Wed 6/20 15:00–15:45 PST which matches your second preference. Please accept if that works. If not, Ben's other slot on Thu 6/21 09:00 PST also works.

Agenda (45 min):
- 10m intro & product fit
- 15m workload walkthrough (you share sample prompts + sequences)
- 15m Dedicated sizing & throughput test plan
- 5m next steps & Mutal Action Plan

Attachments: redwood-sla-summary.pdf, dedicated-sizing.xlsx (filled template)

Grace O'Connor
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 510-555-0167

Hi Grace / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround and the worksheet. We started filling the sizing sheet but an urgent sync with our infra team popped up and we'll need to move the Wed 6/20 15:00 PST slot. Apologies for the short notice.

New availability (PST):
- Fri 6/23 11:00–11:45
- Mon 6/26 14:00–14:45

We still intend to run a short throughput test during the session; we'll bring our infra lead (Maya) and one engineer.

If either of those slots works for your side, please send an updated calendar invite. If not, Ben / Grace — suggest an alternative and we will prioritize.

Alex
